attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Gaby Pacheco congratulates President Barack Obama for announcing the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Immigrant youth grow up attending schools, churches, and places of recreation in the United States.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Immigrant youth come to the United States with desires and ideals of liberty, justice, and the pursuit of happiness, similar to the forefathers.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Lawmakers must work together to protect the rights of all and create a roadmap allowing immigrants to become full-fledged citizens, according to Gaby Pacheco.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Immigrant youth can help make America a more just and prosperous country through their dreams, work, and talent, according to Gaby Pacheco.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
